accessibility.description: ParalivesAccess adds screen-reader output and keyboard navigation on Windows for menus, character creation, storyteller controls, town and current-lot exploration, and Para group selection. Build-mode accessibility is limited: the build catalogue supports finding and placing objects with overlap reports, but comprehensive building support is not yet available. The author recommends starting with a furnished house.
